scope: Theorem 6.1 (Additive primitive packets) of the manuscript “Uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles” (preprints/uniform-bounds-for-planar-polynomial-limit-cycles-September-24-2026/uniform-bounds-for-planar-polynomial-limit-cycles-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 143 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ff8e55372a94e4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 68. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under these assumptions, the output maps of (6.5) and (6.6) satisfy the packet conditions of Definition 3.1 and the differentiated primitive conditions of Assumption 4.2. They have no exceptional column loss: every working column is safe. Their only nonholomorphic defects above the first band have simple costs eℜfi and, when q is large, eℜfl , where i, l are the leading indices of Q, q. Each cost is used only while its log formula is retained. The complete terminal coefficient germs, on each lateral determination, are unchanged by inserting unused nodes and by retesting a fixed finite construction on a permitted refinement preserving the old active free nodes, with the same lifted relations and limiting ordinary data. In particular this primitive library is retestable for elimination in the sense of Definition 5.6, with the fixed local lateral determinations.
